title: Nourishing Australian Flour Wrap
description: A cultured, juicy midnight craving dish featuring flour and steamed leaf wraps, perfect for a Buddhist temple-friendly vegan lunch.
instructions: In a bowl mix whole-wheat flour, salt, and warm water to form a smooth dough and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Roll the dough into thin circles about 12 inches in diameter.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and brush lightly with olive oil; place a dough circle and cook for 1 minute per side until golden.
Steam the spinach leaves until wilted, then cool them to room temperature.
Spread tahini sauce evenly over each cooked dough circle.
Arrange roasted beetroot slices, avocado cubes, and cucumber strips on half of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and roll into a tight wrap.
Warm the wraps in the skillet for 1 minute each side to seal.
Slice or serve whole, and enjoy as a midnight snack.
